entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Haitian Revolution, a transformative movement in Dominican Republic (1791–1808). Emerged from Treaty of Basel and Spain ceded the entire island to France in the Treaty. Catalyzed Treaty of Basel cedes Santo Domingo to France 1795 and Toussaint Louverture briefly unifies Hispaniola 1801.
